title: Readers of The Sacred Mushroom find mushrooms in their backyards
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Readers of The Sacred Mushroom find mushrooms in their backyards, about 1960s-1970s at not stated, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies the paranormal, tells Jesse Michels's podcast what he heard from Andrija Puharich, a scientist who wrote a book called The Sacred Mushroom about a mind-altering mushroom. Mishlove says Puharich told him that people who read the book in the 1960s and 70s found those same mushrooms growing in their backyards within days. As told, it is a strange coincidence that hints at some hidden link between mind and world.
